note: Both sets mix useful chart readings with legend-derived trivia, but Set A contains several clear misbindings: it assigns the ~55 mm and ~40 mm medium-density-foam band thicknesses to glass_triax, and gives two mutually contradictory CarbonUD thicknesses (100 mm and 80 mm) for the same FFA-W3-301 pressure-side location. Set B's numeric readings (CarbonUD ~98–100 mm at FFA-W3-301 pressure side, ~45–50 mm at FFA-W3-211, foam and glass_triax bands at 77% span) are consistent with the plotted bands and it correctly ties glass_uni to the trailing edge of the FFA-W3-360 chart. Set B's main errors are a CarbonUD 3 mm claim attributed to the bottom (100% span) chart where no CarbonUD is plotted, a glass_triax 40 mm claim that reads the foam band, and one LE claim supported only by the label 'LE'. Overall Set B is more faithful and internally consistent.
